Tarikh | Episode 1031 | 30 July 2025
Muthulakshmi Reddy, born in Pudukkottai in 1886 to a father who was a college principal and a mother from a Devadasi family, fought against being made a Devadasi and insisted on education.
In 1907, she became the first woman to join Madras Medical College's surgery department, graduating with a gold medal in 1912 and becoming India's first female house surgeon.
She entered legislative politics in 1926 as the first nominated female member of the Madras Legislative Council, becoming its Deputy Chairperson and championing women's and children's rights.
